name: tonelab
description: Control your DAW in words: tracks, mixer and any plugin's parameters, each change read back from the DAW.
long_description: Tonelab finds the track, the plugin and the parameter you mean, changes it, and reports what the DAW says the value became. REAPER, Ableton Live and FL Studio. Undo goes to the DAW's own history. Runs on your machine; no account or key is needed.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.description: The project's tracks by number and name

tools.name: get_param
tools.description: Read a track's volume, pan, mute, solo or send

tools.name: set_param
tools.description: Set one, confirmed by the DAW

tools.name: find_params
tools.description: Find an effect parameter by what it does

tools.name: set_fx_param
tools.description: Set an effect parameter, confirmed by the DAW

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Take back the DAW's last change

tools.name: search
tools.description: Web search for advice, when set up
